cv.name: Thomas Baumgartner
cv.headline: Head of Compliance | Private Banking & Trade Finance | AML, FINMA
cv.summary: Compliance leader with eighteen years in Swiss banking. Built and led compliance functions under FINMA supervision covering AML, sanctions, cross-border and conduct risk, and represented the bank with regulators and auditors.

experience.title: Head Compliance (MD, ExCo-1)
bullets: Lead a compliance and AML team of 22 across Zurich, Geneva and Lugano
Steered the remediation programme after a FINMA on-site review; all findings closed within 14 months
Introduced a risk-based client review model covering 9,000 relationships
Report quarterly to the Board's Audit & Risk Committee

experience.title: Director, Regulatory Compliance / Dep. CCO
bullets: Built the sanctions screening framework for commodity trade finance
Managed the relationship with the external audit firm

experience.title: VP – Compliance Advisory (AML Officer)
bullets: Advised wealth management desks on cross-border rules and KYC
